svg.title: 10d Requisition PR-2026-0096: Solar backup system

g.text: 10 kVA hybrid inverter · 20 kWh lithium batteries · 3-year service
Power cuts stop training 2–3 days a week; the hub's diesel generator costs UGX 1.1M a month in fuel.

svg.text: Funds are reserved when the last step approves

g.text: Until then this request reserves nothing, so other requisitions on the line see the available
balance above. On approval it is reserved; the LPO later commits it.
